subject.title: feat(android): platform trust for public gateway certs + manual fingerprint pinning

question: Should eligible public DNS gateway hosts use Android platform trust by default while retaining explicit pins for existing and LAN/IP endpoints?
rationale: This changes the product’s TLS identity model for new public-host connections; code review can assess implementation details but cannot choose the intended long-term trust policy.

options.title: Approve platform trust with parser repair
options.body: Keep the proposed public-host system-trust policy, add support for standard OpenSSL fingerprint output, and require targeted validation of both system-trust and pin-preserving paths.

options.title: Keep universal pinning
options.body: Reject the new default and limit any follow-up to improving the existing pinning recovery UX without changing the connection trust model.

recommendation.title: Approve platform trust with parser repair
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed public-host system-trust policy, add support for standard OpenSSL fingerprint output, and require targeted validation of both system-trust and pin-preserving paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete ownership signal in the supplied history is the current Android TLS implementation and its accompanying test work.
